parsed.name: Byonoy Absorbance 96 酶标仪
parsed.description: 这是一款面向96孔微孔板的吸光度酶标仪，用于在选定波长下测量各孔样品的吸光度信号。它适用于ELISA、比色分析以及其他基于微孔板的常规实验检测。
parsed.description_en: This is a 96-well microplate absorbance reader used to measure sample absorbance in plate wells at selected wavelengths. It is suitable for ELISA, colorimetric assays, and other routine microplate-based laboratory measurements.

actions.description: 执行参考吸光度初始化测量。
actions.description_en: Perform the reference absorbance initialization measurement.

actions.description: 测量微孔板指定孔位在指定波长下的吸光度。
actions.description_en: Measure absorbance in selected plate wells at the specified wavelength.

actions.description: 测量微孔板指定孔位在给定激发波长、发射波长和焦高条件下的荧光信号。
actions.description_en: Measure fluorescence in selected plate wells using the given excitation wavelength, emission wavelength, and focal height.

actions.description: 测量微孔板指定孔位在给定焦高条件下的发光信号。
actions.description_en: Measure luminescence in selected plate wells at the given focal height.

actions.description: 初始化并准备酶标仪进行测量。
actions.description_en: Initialize and prepare the plate reader for measurement.
Send a low-level command to the device.
